articles.title: Netomi CEO says $5 trillion AI customer experience market could boost stablecoin demand
articles.snippet: Puneet Mehta, a former high-level Wall Street engineer and data scientist, said the rapid expansion of AI enterprise software will increase demand for stablecoins and blockchain.

articles.title: Bitcoin trims losses after core CPI rises less than feared 0.2% in May
articles.snippet: Headline inflation rose an expected 0.5% in May, but the beat on the core rate — which cuts out food and energy costs — is pleasing markets.

articles.title: XRP market shows signs of capitulation as holders sell at loss
articles.snippet: XRP holders are capitulating, according to data tracked by Glassnode. That suggests a bottom may be near.

articles.title: Bitcoin rises despite US inflation hitting 3-year high: Where will BTC price go?
articles.snippet: BTC's rebound shows signs of weakening under a string of technical resistance levels, raising the odds of a dip below $60,000 in June.

articles.title: Onchain gambling keeps rolling with $14B quarter despite crypto slump: TRM Labs
articles.snippet: TRM Labs said onchain gambling reached $51 billion in 2025, with repeat users and stablecoin flows helping the sector remain resilient during a broader crypto market pullback.
